assistant|chicago_spring_weather: Chicago spring (March-May): average highs 45°F in March warming to 64°F in May; April is the wettest month

assistant|chicago_neighborhood_the_loop: The Loop (Downtown Chicago): central location, close to attractions and transit; can be busy, noisy, limited affordable options

assistant|chicago_neighborhood_west_loop: West Loop: up-and-coming with mix of old and new attractions, close to the Loop; can be a bit industrial

assistant|chicago_coffee_the_allis: The Allis: stylish cafe in the West Loop serving Intelligentsia coffee with pastries and sandwiches

assistant|chicago_coffee_the_coffee_stud: The Coffee Studio: coffee lab and cafe in Lakeview with expertly brewed coffee and rotating single-origin beans
assistant|chicago_coffee_gaslight: Gaslight Coffee Roasters: Logan Square staple with cozy atmosphere and sustainable small-batch roasting

assistant|fl_beach_town_suggestion: Miami Beach - vibrant nightlife, art deco, white-sand beaches; airport MIA
Fort Lauderdale - laid-back, scenic beachfront promenade; airport FLL
Destin - Emerald Coast, pristine beaches, golfing, water sports; airport ECP ~45 min
Sarasota - Gulf Coast, cultural attractions, beaches, kayaking; airport SRQ
Sanibel Island - shell-filled beaches, wildlife refuge; airport RSW ~1 hour
Daytona Beach - surfing, relaxed atmosphere, historic pier; airport DAB
St. Pete Beach - laid-back vibe, beautiful beach, historic pier; airport PIE ~30 min
Pensacola Beach - sugar-white sand, water sports, naval aviation history; airport PNS
Clearwater Beach - beachfront promenade, pier, lively atmosphere; airport PIE
Hollywood Beach - broadwalk, beachside restaurants, laid-back; airport FLL
assistant|relaxed_trip_recommendation: Sarasota - about an hour south of Tampa, charming coastal town
St. Pete Beach - about 30 minutes southwest of Tampa, laid-back
Clearwater Beach - about 30 minutes west of Tampa, relaxed atmosphere
Fort Myers Beach - about 2.5 hours southwest of Tampa, laid-back
assistant|paddleboarding_conditions: Fort Myers Beach has calm, shallow Gulf waters ideal for stand-up paddleboarding
assistant|paddleboard_spot: Matanzas Pass - calm, minimal boat traffic, good for beginners
Bowditch Point Regional Park - scenic park with launch point through mangroves
Estero Bay - larger body of water, relatively calm, good for exploring
assistant|fort_myers_beach_activities: Kayaking, jet-skiing, parasailing, deep-sea and back bay fishing, boat tours

Fort Myers Beach Hotel - beachfront, pool, beachside bar, free breakfast buffet
Pointe Estero Beach Resort - spacious rooms, multiple pools, fitness center
GullWing Beach Resort - beachfront, pool, free breakfast buffet
